title: Drying of municipal sewage sludge: from a laboratory scale batch indirect dryer to the paddle dryer
material_identity: Same characterized unincinerated activated sludge as Arlabosse2005; 85/15 percent refers to wastewater feed origin, not a dry formulation. Industrial recycled material and exact aliquot correspondence are not fully identified.

a.derivation: author estimated coefficient; fit details and residuals unknown

b.derivation: author estimated coefficient; fit details and residuals unknown

source_equation: F=a*W+b, kg water/(m2 h), W=kg water/kg dry matter
source_conflict: Printed Eq6 omits b and is not the solution of Eqs3+4; this implementation integrates Eq3 with b retained, a derived correction, not an author erratum.

joint_exploration_domain.thermal_control: prescribed constant material temperature; net heat is a calculated requirement
joint_exploration_domain.geometry: Explicit dry mass and nominal heated/contact area using the same normalization as source F; no additional hidden contact coverage factor or inferred experimental loading.
joint_exploration_domain.vapor_boundary: Explicit externally maintained water-vapor partial pressure below model equilibrium pressure throughout the path, at 1bar total pressure. No external gas flow/transport prediction; source rate sensitivity to gas conditions remains unknown.

method: Analytic mass trajectory parameterized by decreasing moisture; exact piecewise thermal q integrals and cumulative signed vapor enthalpy update total H; actual inverse checks recovered T. Sampling is output resolution, not an ODE step tolerance.
